intro: Sentry Point is a human watchtower stationed on the mainland edge of Dustwallow Marsh, guarding the causeway bridge that leads directly to Theramore Isle. Maintained by Theramore's forces, it monitors traffic entering and exiting Lady Jaina Proudmoore's island citadel.

p: Positioned at the western end of the long bridge linking Theramore Isle to the treacherous wetlands of Dustwallow Marsh, Sentry Point serves as the stronghold's first line of defense on the mainland. The stone scout tower keeps watch over the swamp road, ensuring that hostile marsh beasts or Horde raiders cannot approach the island city unnoticed.
